meta.title: Black Ridge Hunt
meta.subtitle: 🏔 You arrive at a remote mountain camp for opening weekend of deer season. Every decision shapes the hunt.
meta.historyEmptyText: Your path will be recorded here as you make choices.
meta.footerText: 🏹 The Black Ridge Hunt · Chapter One

scenes.title: 🏔 Arrival at Black Ridge
scenes.narrative:
Your truck rolls to a stop beside an old logging road as the last light fades behind the mountains.

🌲 Black Ridge feels ancient and quiet.

Cold air drifts through the pines while a creek murmurs somewhere below camp.

Tomorrow is opening morning.

You still have enough daylight left to make one good decision before darkness settles over the ridge.

choices.text: 🔥 Build a fire and plan the morning

scenes.title: ⛺ Camp in Good Order
scenes.narrative:
You work methodically.

Tent first. Lantern second. Food hung safely away from camp.

As darkness thickens, you notice fresh deer tracks pressed into the mud nearby.

🦌 Something sizeable passed through recently.

choices.text: 😴 Get some sleep for an early hunt

scenes.title: 🥾 Scouting the Trail
scenes.narrative:
You move quietly along a narrow trail winding through pine and fir.

A few hundred yards from camp, the trail splits.

⬆ One path climbs toward a rocky overlook.
🌲 The other disappears into thick timber.

Nearby, bark has been rubbed raw on a sapling — fresh buck sign.

scenes.title: 🌊 Tracks by the Creek
scenes.narrative:
You follow the sound of moving water down the slope.

🦌 The muddy creek bank is packed with fresh tracks.

One set is much larger than the others.

Then somewhere upstream… a branch snaps.

The woods go silent.

scenes.title: 🔥 Firelight
scenes.narrative:
You keep the fire small and controlled.

🌙 Cold night air settles around camp while you think through tomorrow's hunt.

Creek crossing.
The overlook.
Still-hunting the timber.

Every option has risks.

Somewhere beyond the firelight, something moves in the dark.

choices.text: 🌊 Hunt the creek crossing at dawn
🏔 Climb to the overlook before sunrise
👂 Stay awake listening to the woods

scenes.title: 👁 Fresh Sign
scenes.narrative:
The sign is even better than you expected.

Fresh tracks overlap near a scrape beneath low branches.

🦌 A buck has definitely been working this area recently.

But daylight is disappearing fast.

choices.text: 🏔 Circle uphill for a better route

scenes.title: 🌅 Before Dawn
scenes.narrative:
Frost coats the ground when you wake.

The woods are silent in that strange way only mountains can be before sunrise.

☕ You sip something hot and shoulder your pack.

Opening morning has arrived.

scenes.title: 🏔 The Overlook
scenes.narrative:
You reach a rocky shelf overlooking the valley below.

🌲 Meadows, brush pockets, and winding timber stretch across Black Ridge.

Far below, something tan slips through the trees.

🦌 Deer are definitely moving through this area.

scenes.title: 🌲 Thick Timber
scenes.narrative:
The woods swallow the fading light.

Brush tangles around your boots while the scent of deer hangs in the cold air.

Then movement.

👁 A shadow slips silently between the trees ahead.

scenes.title: 🌊 The Creek Crossing
scenes.narrative:
Fog drifts above the water while the first sunlight reaches the ridge.

🦌 A doe steps cautiously into the crossing.

Then behind her, deeper in the timber, antlers catch the morning light for just a second.

scenes.title: ☀ First Light
scenes.narrative:
You settle behind a rocky outcrop overlooking the valley.

As sunlight spills across the ridge, you finally spot him.

🦌 A mature buck feeding at the edge of a clearing below.

The wind is steady.

The shot won't stay open forever.

scenes.title: ✨ Patience Pays
scenes.narrative:
You stay perfectly still.

The doe crosses first.

Then the buck steps fully into the open.

Heavy neck. Wide frame.

🦌 Bigger than you expected.

scenes.title: 🥾 Closing the Distance
scenes.narrative:
You move carefully through folds in the hillside, using brush and terrain to stay hidden.

At last you see the buck again through the branches.

🦌 He still has no idea you're there.

scenes.title: ⚠ The Missed Chance
scenes.narrative:
You rush the shot.

🌲 The woods explode with movement as the deer vanish into the ridge.

The chance is gone.

But Black Ridge taught you something important.

Patience matters more than speed.

scenes.title: 🏆 Opening Morning Success
scenes.narrative:
You steady yourself and squeeze the trigger.

🦌 The buck drops within sight of the overlook.

For a moment, the entire ridge feels silent.

All the preparation, cold mornings, and careful choices led to this moment.

It's a hunt you will remember for years.

scenes.title: 🦌 A Clean Harvest
scenes.narrative:
You take the shot only when it feels right.

The buck drops cleanly.

🌲 Silence returns to the woods.

When you approach, you feel only gratitude and respect.

Black Ridge gave you an honest opportunity.

And you earned it.

scenes.title: 🌫 Almost
scenes.narrative:
The opportunity is real… but not perfect.

By the time the shot breaks, the moment is already slipping away.

🦌 The buck disappears back into the timber.

Not the ending you hoped for.

But enough to make you want to return to Black Ridge again.

scenes.title: 🌲 The One That Walked
scenes.narrative:
You choose not to shoot.

Maybe the angle isn't right.

Maybe the moment itself feels more important.

🦌 You watch the buck disappear into the fading light.

You return to camp empty-handed… but deeply satisfied.

Not every successful hunt ends with a trigger pull.
